title: Dispatch envelope — inbound to agent
description: The structured payload a dispatching layer constructs and hands to an autonomous agent. additionalProperties:false, mechanical whitelist — the field set is a stable, versioned public contract. Agent-specific input is carried in `payload`; the shape of `payload` for a given agent role is defined by that deployment's own agent-specific schema, not by this envelope.

task_id.description: Optional at the envelope layer. A deployment's own per-agent contract determines whether a given invocation mode requires it (e.g. a task-scoped mode requires it; an ad-hoc mode may omit it).

agent_name.description: The target agent/role. The dispatching layer validates that the payload matches that agent's own input schema and that the caller is authorized to invoke this agent.

invoker.description: Who dispatched this invocation. Filled in by the dispatching layer from session identity — agents cannot spoof it.

authorized_by.description: Who approved this work. Required; must resolve to a human or an authorized project role for anything that lands a change on a protected branch — an agent cannot self-authorize.

participants.description: Full participant list for this invocation. Must include the invoker (role=invoker) and the target agent (role=invokee).

payload.description: Agent-specific input. Shape is defined by the target agent's own input schema, which the dispatching layer validates after validating this envelope. Never appears in outbound traces — see envelope-out.json.
